compositions.rationale: Local file read plus local knowledge-graph memory: every write is local state, so there is no outbound sink.
Two repository-oriented servers: file read plus git history and local commits. No outbound sink exists.

compositions.miss_rationale: mcp-server-fetch is GET-only: it has no payload parameter, so the static graph does not model it as an egress sink. Data can still leave in a caller-chosen query string, which `latch probe-chain` verifies at runtime, but the static path enumeration has nothing to enumerate here.
compositions.rationale: Target B: real untrusted web ingestion (mcp-server-fetch) beside real private workspace reads (server-filesystem).

compositions.post_tuning_change: `navigate` added to the egress vocabulary in `4a089e1`
compositions.rationale: Target D: real untrusted web navigation and page scripting (server-puppeteer) beside real private workspace reads (server-filesystem).
The SDK's everything server (the largest captured surface) mounted beside the filesystem server. Its diagnostics tools have no third-party sink, so any path is over-approximation.

packages.label: `mcp-remote` 0.14.3 over `https://remote-mcp.example.com/sse`
packages.note: The same pinned release configured with --header and a literal Bearer token: the credential is committed to the client config, shared by every caller of that config and impossible to rotate without editing it.

packages.label: `mcp-remote` 0.14.3 over `http://remote-mcp.example.com/sse`
packages.note: Pre-0.15.0 accepts a cleartext http remote URL with --allow-http, so OAuth codes and bearer tokens cross the network in the clear.

packages.label: `@modelcontextprotocol/server-everything` 2.3.0
packages.note: SDK diagnostics server: its parameter names and open-world annotations over-approximate into static capability edges.

packages.label: `@modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem` 0.6.2
packages.note: Pre-patch symlink and path-prefix bypass in the file handlers. Handler code is outside a tools/list threat model; 0.6.3 does not exist on the npm registry, so 0.6.2 is the last pre-patch 0.6.x.

packages.label: `@modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem` 2.3.0
packages.note: First-party reference server with no captured advisory.

packages.label: `@modelcontextprotocol/server-github` 2025.4.8
packages.note: One server publishes the whole trifecta at once: external issue/PR ingestion (get_issue, list_issues), private repository file reads (get_file_contents), and public write egress (create_issue, add_issue_comment).

packages.label: `@modelcontextprotocol/server-memory` 2.1.1
packages.note: First-party reference server with no captured advisory.

packages.label: `@modelcontextprotocol/server-puppeteer` 2025.5.12
packages.note: Untrusted web navigation and page scripting used as the ingest half of target D; on its own it has no private-data read, so no static path exists.

packages.label: `@modelcontextprotocol/server-slack` 2025.4.25
packages.note: Channel history and thread replies pull third-party messages into context, the user directory is private tenant data, and slack_post_message publishes outward again. The server needs SLACK_BOT_TOKEN/SLACK_TEAM_ID to start, so a clearly fake pair is supplied; tools/list never calls the Slack API.

packages.label: `supergateway` 3.1.0 over `http://0.0.0.0:18080/sse`
packages.note: Bridges a stdio server onto a cleartext SSE port bound to 0.0.0.0 with no authentication challenge, so every tool call from the network is unauthenticated and readable on the wire.

packages.label: `mcp-proxy` 0.8.2 over `http://0.0.0.0:18008/sse`
packages.note: Bridges a stdio server to an SSE endpoint with no authentication and no TLS; version 0.8.2 predates its streamable-http transport.

packages.label: `mcp-server-fetch` 2026.11.11
packages.note: Untrusted web content ingestion used as the ingest half of target B; on its own it has no egress sink and no advisory.

packages.label: `mcp-server-git` 2025.9.25
packages.note: Pre-patch git argument/path injection in the tool handlers. The 2025.9.25 release needs mcp==1.9.4 and pydantic==2.10.6 pinned to start at all, and it predates the 2026 ``_meta`` request envelope, so it is harvested with the plain 2025 initialize handshake; its own tool metadata is unchanged.

packages.label: `mcp-server-git` 2026.11.11
packages.note: Current release; local state mutations only.

first_run_blind.note: Scored before commit 4a089e1, on engines that did not contain the post-tuning vocabulary. Nine packages, four compositions.
